dev-s272a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Quartz is a production endpoint, serving Brightwater Health, owned by team ridge
Grace Achterberg (staff id u70896) leads team ridge
Samuel Oyelaran (staff id u15695) is on team ridge and leads no team

timeline.text: Change request CR-9380 to disable the classifier for deploy 2567 on Project Quartz is approved by Samuel Oyelaran
Incident INC-6798 opens on Project Quartz; a rollback starts
Deploy 2567 turns the safety classifier off on Project Quartz (production) during rollback INC-6798
Monitoring shows Project Quartz serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 2567 turned the classifier off on Project Quartz, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team ridge (CR-9380 was approved by Samuel Oyelaran, who doesn't lead team ridge).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-9380 was approved by someone who leads no team.
